<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex19062023-07-2412-58" status="unreviewed">bden pa gnyis thabs dang thabs las byung ba nyid du lung gzhan gyis kyang sgrub pa ni | kun rdzob ces pa ste | 'di ni 'phags pa'i lam gyi tshogs dag la bya ste | kun rdzob yang dag pa <lb edRef="inst:4604" n="14a4"/> zhes bya ces <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">dge bshes ston pa</rs> gsung ba lags par gda' ||
          de'i skas myed par don dam rtogs pa mthar phyin pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi steng du mi phyin ces pa las | lam gyi rtogs pa nyid du skye ba shes rab kyis don dam pa'i bden pa bsgoms pa las skye ste | <lb edRef="inst:4604" n="14a5"/> de nyid la tha snyad brjod pa'i bdag nyid dang thabs thams cad dgos pa sngar bstan pa bzhin du yin la | skye myed sgom pa la bde' 'gro'i rten thob dgos la de la yang thabs kyi cha dag dgos te | </seg></TEI>
